charts.title: Kepler-445 b: orbits around Kepler-445
charts.description: The orbits of Kepler-445's planets in this map from above, to scale, with Kepler-445 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Mann et al. 2017 (2017AJ....153..267M), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname MANN_ET_AL__2017): P 2.9841664 d
